app.title: Research Management
app.turnedAway: {{path}} is not a page your account can open, so this is your own home instead.

auth.invitedNote: Invited? Open the link in your invitation email to set a password. The professor can send you a new one if it has expired.

accept.title: Set your password
accept.intro: Your invitation is confirmed by this link. Choose a password and you are signed in.
accept.name: Your name (optional)
accept.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
accept.noToken: This link carries no invitation token. Open the link from your invitation email exactly as it was sent — some mail clients cut long links in half.
accept.expiryNote: An invitation link works once and expires after seven days. Ask the professor for a new one if this fails.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: This link confirms the request. Set a new password and sign in with it.
reset.done: Your password is set. Sign in with it below.
reset.noToken: This link carries no recovery token. Open the link from your email exactly as it was sent, or ask for a new one below.
reset.requested: If that address has an account, a recovery link is on its way. The link works once and expires in two hours.

me.title: This week
me.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed for this week.
me.noPeriod: No reporting period has been configured yet.
me.releasedNote: An assessment appears here once your professor has approved it.
me.toProfile: Your assessments and your progress on every project →

report.title: Weekly package
report.alreadySubmitted: Submitted {{when}} — sending again adds a version; this one is kept
report.resubmitted: Resubmitted {{when}} as version {{version}} — sending again adds a version; every earlier one is kept
report.hoursOutOfRange: Hours has to be between 0 and 168 — a week is 168 hours.
report.hoursNotANumber: Hours has to be a number, or empty.
report.hoursBlocks: Check the hours on {{project}} before sending.
report.stillOwed_one: {{count}} project still has no entry in it
report.stillOwed_other: {{count}} projects still have no entry in it
report.missingEntries: No entry for {{projects}}. The package has to cover every project you are on this week.
report.unknownPeriod: That reporting week does not exist, or is not one of yours.

fields.hoursNote: Self-reported; not treated as verified productivity.

attachments.title: Evidence
attachments.claimPlaceholder: The run log behind the nDCG number
attachments.claimNote: Your description of what this supports, applied to the next file or link you attach. Recorded as your claim, not as a finding.
attachments.linkInvalid: That is not a web address. A link has to start with http:// or https://.
attachments.limit: Up to 25 MB per file. Slides (PPTX), documents (DOCX), Markdown, HTML, PDF, figures, notebooks and data files.
attachments.checking: Checking {{name}} before it leaves your machine…
attachments.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? The file and its extracted text are deleted, and it stops being searchable.
attachments.removeLinkConfirm: Remove {{name}}? The link and the text read from it stop being evidence for this week and stop being searchable. The page itself is untouched.

reader.title: Weekly report
reader.notStarted: Nothing was started for this week.
reader.notSubmitted: This week has a draft but nothing has been submitted, so there is nothing on the record to read.
reader.revisionPlaceholder: What needs to change, and why

overview.title: Overview
overview.unavailable: The overview could not be loaded.
overview.nothingOutstanding: Every obligation for this week has been met.
overview.syncNote: A stale repository means the evidence is incomplete, not that no work was done.
overview.stalledNote: Each of these is retryable and none of them changed a report or its timestamp. A retry that succeeds takes its row off this list.
overview.weekEmpty: No reports are owed this week. Derive the obligations below once projects are active and students are on them.
overview.weekNote: One row per reporting obligation, so an excused or extended one is listed and marked rather than counted as owed. Submission is read from the report's current version, which is the same place the student's own screen reads it.
overview.deriveNote: The nightly job does this too.

evidence.noCitations: No citations — nothing here rests on a retrieved record.

review.title: Review
review.subject: This student
review.unavailable: This assessment could not be loaded.
review.noEvidence: The snapshot is empty. Ratings cannot rest on anything.
review.rationalePlaceholder: Why you are changing a rating. Recorded with the approval.
review.rationaleRequired: A changed rating needs a recorded reason before it can be approved.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.question: Question
assistant.placeholder: Which reports are missing this week?
assistant.readOnly: Read-only. It can draft text; sending, approving and changing remain your actions.
assistant.failed: The question could not be answered.
assistant.factsNote: Computed from the database, not written by the model.
assistant.synthesisNote: The model's reading of the facts and evidence above.
assistant.suggestionsNote: Drafts for you to act on, never actions taken.
assistant.keepScope: Keep this scope for follow-up questions

project.unavailable: This project could not be loaded.
project.progressNote: Computed from milestone weights and accepted completion — never from student scores.
project.noWeights: Not available — no milestone weights are set.
project.noMembers: Nobody is assigned to this project.
project.activateNote: A student owes a weekly report only for an active project. While this one is proposed, assigning someone produces nothing.
project.noStudents: No students in this workspace yet — invite one on
project.openToJoinNote: A student can put themselves on an open project without being assigned. Being on a project shows them its plan, milestones, tasks and decisions, and who else works on it.
project.leaveNote: This ends your part in it. The project stops appearing in your week, including this one, what you have already submitted stays on the record, and the project itself carries on for whoever else is on it.
project.leaveConfirm: Leave {{title}}? You cannot rejoin unless your professor opens the project again.
project.leftNotice: You left this project on {{when}}. The record stays readable because your reports and assessments refer to it; its milestones, decisions and members are no longer shown.

student.title: Student
student.rubricBreak: These points span {{count}} rubric versions and are not one comparable series.
student.noAssessments: No assessment has been produced yet.
student.noMaterials: This student has not attached anything yet.
student.materialsNote: Every file and link this student attached to a weekly package.
student.label: Research profile

people.title: People
people.label: Workspace roll
people.intro: Everyone with an account here. Enrolment is by invitation, and a role is fixed once the invitation is accepted — it cannot be changed afterwards from the application.
people.name: Name (optional)
people.roleNote: The invitation link is emailed to the address, never shown here. A professor invited as a colleague has the same authority over students as you do.
people.removeWarning: Removing {{name}} ends every project membership and closes the account, so no further weekly reports are owed. Their submitted work and assessments are kept. This cannot be undone — returning means a fresh invitation.
people.elsewhere: Join its workspace to act on this account

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.name: Name
workspaces.createNote: A new workspace starts empty, you join it, and you keep every workspace you were already in.
workspaces.note: You can belong to several workspaces at once. Joining adds one and leaving gives it up; the one marked Working here is what every other screen shows. Archiving ends a workspace nobody belongs to, and it leaves this list.

calendar.title: Reporting calendar
calendar.intro: When the week runs, when you meet, and therefore when a report is due. Nothing can become due until this is set.
calendar.none: No calendar is configured, so no reporting week exists yet.
calendar.configured: Weeks start on {{start}}, you meet on {{meeting}}, in {{timezone}}. Version {{version}}.
calendar.versionNote: Saving writes a new version. Weeks that are already open keep the deadline they were created with; the change applies to weeks opened after it.
calendar.autoNote: The nightly job opens weeks and derives obligations by itself. This button is for not waiting until tomorrow.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A student owes a weekly report for each active project they are assigned to.
projects.createNote: A new project is proposed. Nothing is owed on it until it is active and a student is assigned — both on the project's own page.
projects.createNoteStudent: Your project is active as soon as you create it, and you are on it — so a report for it is owed for this week, from now.
projects.joinableNote: Your professor has opened these. Joining puts a weekly report for the project on your plate from next week.
projects.repoUrlHint: Optional. A link so people on the project can find the code. This does not connect the repository — commits are not read and nothing is attributed from it.

myAssessment.title: Released assessment
myAssessment.indexNote: Read the index beside its components below, not on its own.
myAssessment.noFeedback: No written feedback on this assessment.
myAssessment.correctionPlaceholder: What is wrong, and what evidence supports your account?
myAssessment.correctionNote: Your request is recorded with your evidence and sent to your professor. It does not by itself change a rating.
myAssessment.unavailable: This assessment is not available to you.

budget.title: Model spend
budget.intro: A monthly ceiling on what analysis may cost in this workspace. Assessments are delayed once it is reached, and resume when it is raised or the month rolls over.
budget.configured: ${{spent}} spent this month, against a ceiling of ${{limit}}.
budget.none: ${{spent}} spent this month. No ceiling is set, so analysis is never refused for want of one.
budget.usage: {{calls}} model call(s) this month, {{failed}} of them failed. ${{cost}} at published rates.
budget.note: Leave it empty for no ceiling. Zero is not the same thing: it stops every analysis until it is changed.
